listing.name: Fatal Fury 3: Road to the Final Victory (Neo Geo) / Fatal-Fury-3-Recomp (omegakatana92)
listing.summary: Native static recompilation of Fatal Fury 3: Road to the Final Victory for Windows x64 and Steam Deck/Linux. The 68000 code is translated to C and runs on the neogeorecomp MVS board model with the real BIOS; Musashi covers remaining paths. SDL2 video/audio, YM2610 sound, 99.6% measured native coverage. No ROMs or BIOS. PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0.
